description: This PHP file contains a unit test class 'HolidayDaoTest' that tests the functionalities of the 'HolidayDao' class within the OrangeHRM HR management system. The tests include retrieving, saving, searching, and deleting holiday records, and it uses mock data to verify the behavior of holiday data access operations.

classes.name: HolidayDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class extending a base test case to verify the functionality of 'HolidayDao' related to holiday records, including CRUD operations and search filters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the HolidayDao instance and populates test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetHolidayById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a holiday by its ID and verifies the entity type, recurrence status, and date.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving modifications to an existing holiday and verifies the persisted data.

methods.name: testSaveHolidayWithNoId
methods.description: Tests saving a new holiday without an existing ID and verifies the assigned ID and name.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDates
methods.description: Tests searching holidays without date filters, expecting all recurring holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDatesAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching holidays with the exclude recurring filter applied; expects zero results if no non-recurring holidays are present.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching with only an end date and exclude recurring filter.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutToDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching with only a start date and exclude recurring filter.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests complex date range filters with exclude recurring set, checking the returned holiday names and count.

methods.name: testSearchHolidays
methods.description: Tests searching holidays within a date range; verifies total count and specific holiday names.

methods.name: testGetHolidayByDate
methods.description: Tests fetching a holiday by specific date and verifies the holiday name.

methods.name: testDeleteHolidays
methods.description: Tests deleting a list of holidays by their IDs and verifies the number of deletions.
